**About Pushnami** 




  





 Pushnami is a fast\-growing, Austin\-based tech company powering personalized website notifications and monetization for over 10,000 sites globally. Founded in 2017, we’ve grown to deliver over 1 billion messages a day across all channels and help our partners drive substantial ROI. By joining Pushnami, you’ll be part of a dynamic team working to double our partners and visitors in 2026, while expanding into exciting new verticals and markets. Our technology boosts performance and revenue for our partners by over 20% on average!
 



  





 At Pushnami, all of our employees are seen as strategic partners who help drive company\-wide outcomes. You’ll be joining an ambitious and self\-motivated culture where experimentation and initiative are encouraged. We value impact over process and are looking for people who want to make a difference—not just check boxes and write code. If you're passionate about solving business problems with data and want to lead with both technical expertise and business savvy, you will be a great fit for our team!
 



  





 Austin, TX is our homebase and our office is located on the North side of Austin on N Lamar Blvd next to Stiles Switch BBQ. We have breakfast and lunch catered every Tuesday, once a month on Thursday, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and drinks. While this position is mostly remote, we encourage in\-office attendance on Tuesdays and on the Thursday preceding our monthly "3rd Friday," when the entire company has the day off.
 



  





 We're proud of the culture we've built, and our team agrees! Check out our 4\.6 Glassdoor rating to hear it from them directly. But the recognition doesn't stop there:
 



  




* 6x Best Place to Work in Austin (Built In)
* 2x Inc. Magazine Best Workplaces (2020, 2023\)
* \#1 Fastest\-Growing Company in Central Texas (Austin Business Journal)
* \#2 Fastest\-Growing Private Company in Texas (Inc. Magazine)
* Inc. Best in Business — Software (2022\)
* Our CEO was an EY Entrepreneur of the Year Finalist (2024\)



  





**The Role** 




  





 The Data Scientist will build the models and experiments that decide what we show, to whom, and what we pay for it. We route and monetize traffic across thousands of publishers — every one of those decisions is a prediction problem with revenue attached.
 



  





 This role is a core member of our Data Science \& Analytics team and works closely with Growth, Path, Engineering, Product, Finance, and Customer Success. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning a problem end to end: framing it with a business stakeholder, pulling the data, building the model, designing the test that proves it worked, and shipping it into production where it makes real decisions. This is an AI\-First role, meaning all of your development will be AI\-assisted.
 



  





**What You'll Actually Do** 




  




* **Build models that improve performance for our advertisers and publishers.** 
 Offer and content scoring, user propensity and LTV, send\-time and frequency optimization, subscriber quality prediction, churn. Our scoring service is built for segment\-level iteration — you'll define segments, test strategies against them, and ship without waiting on an engineering cycle.
* **Own experimentation.** 
 Design and analyze A/B tests in GrowthBook, set the standards for how we call a winner, and push back when a result doesn't hold up.
* **Do the causal work behind the revenue.** 
 RPV and yield analysis, sub\-ID and publisher\-level performance, fraud and traffic\-quality detection, incrementality on partner and channel spend. Figure out what actually drove a number instead of what correlated with it.
* **Put models into production.** 
 Your work runs on AWS (Athena, Glue, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB) against real traffic, with monitoring and alerting you own. A model in a notebook isn't a result.
* **Ship fast using AI tools** 
 (primarily Claude Code). You'll write prompts and AI specs, manage context, verify output, and push to production with AI.
* **Partner with non\-technical teams** 
 to translate their problems into data solutions and show what's possible. Much of the highest\-value work here starts as a question someone in Growth or Path didn't know was answerable.



  





**What AI\-first means here:** 



* Every engineer has either Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor Pro (company\-managed licenses)
* We use AI as agents for all tasks, not just as an autocomplete tool
* We've successfully deployed AI agents for product management and reporting
* We maintain shared prompt libraries (an internal Claude Code Plugin Marketplace) and a custom RAG knowledge base to create a culture of compound engineering in AI\-assisted development



  





**Hiring Process:** 
 The hiring process will start with a Zoom screener with the hiring manager.
 



  





**Candidate Requirements:** 



* **Applied modeling experience.** 
 You've built models that shipped and changed a business outcome — ranking, propensity, forecasting, uplift, anomaly detection, or similar. Bring the one you're proudest of and the one that failed.
* **Real experimentation experience.** 
 A/B test design, power and sample size, sequential testing pitfalls, and the judgment to know when an observational estimate is good enough and when it isn't. Familiarity with a platform like GrowthBook, Optimizely, or Statsig is a plus.
* **Strong fundamentals.** 
 Python (pandas, scikit\-learn, and the stats stack). Advanced SQL. AWS (Athena, Glue, Lambda, S3\). Comfortable enough with data engineering to build the pipeline your model needs rather than filing a ticket for it. Bachelor's or advanced degree in a technical field is a plus but not a requirement.
* **Business instinct.** 
 You can tell the difference between a statistically significant result and one worth acting on, and you'd rather ship a simple model that moves revenue than a sophisticated one.
* **High ownership.** 
 You find problems before they're assigned. You ship without waiting for permission.
* **Clear communication.** 
 You can explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders without condescension, and you can tell an executive what a confidence interval means without either overselling or hedging into uselessness.
* **Nice\-to\-haves:** 
 Looker or another BI tool, Terraform, AWS Serverless, Jenkins, bandit/reinforcement learning approaches, real\-time or streaming inference, and ad tech/martech/advertising/marketing experience.
* **Austin\-based, hybrid required.** 
 Two days per week in office. We're building new processes together and being in the same room matters.

* Full Medical and Dental Insurance that is 100% paid for by the company
* 401k Retirement Plan \- Fully matched up to 6%
* Paid parental leave (12 weeks of fully paid leave for primary caregiver, 6 weeks of fully paid leave for secondary caregiver)
* Flexible work in a hybrid work model
* Generous PTO policy with unlimited PTO after the first year
* $100 in “Fringe” benefits monthly (online marketplace where you can purchase the perks you choose – Netflix, Hulu, AirBnb, Royal Caribbean Cruises, child care, dog walking, you name it!)
* Gym Membership at Orange Theory
